crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man’s pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz’;

translations.web: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived, and bore him a son.
translations.bsb: So Hosea went and married Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore him a son.
translations.kjv: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.
translations.asv: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived, and bare him a son.
